course_name_original: Ciencia de Materiales. Estructura y Propiedades

learning_outcomes.text: Demonstrate the ability to analyze and synthesize.
Acquire the ability to solve problems effectively.
Acquire skills related to the use of computer programs for calculation, data analysis, and processing within their field of application.
Develop the ability to work in a team.
Acquire the ability for autonomous learning and concern for knowledge and continuous training.
Develop the ability to adapt to new situations.
Motivation for quality and continuous improvement.
Knowledge of the fundamentals of materials science, technology, and chemistry.
Ability to handle specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Ability to interpret technical projects and reports.

syllabus_topics: Introduction. Atomic structure. Atomic bonds in solids.

Introduction. Fundamental concepts. Unit cell. Crystalline structure of materials. Density calculation. Polymorphism and allotropy. Crystalline systems. Crystallographic directions and planes. Crystalline and non-crystalline materials. Non-crystalline solids.
Introduction. Diffusion mechanisms. Steady-state and non-steady-state diffusion. Diffusion factors. Diffusion and material treatment.
Phase diagram of pure substances. Gibbs' phase rule. Engineering alloys. Isomorphous binary alloy system. Binary eutectic systems.
teaching_methods: Completion of assignments, Reports, Memoranda, and Assessment Tests
assessment_rules: For the first call, assessment consists of 40% continuous assessment of in-person activities, 30% written theory test, and 30% written problem test. For the second call, continuous assessment is 0%, while the written theory test and written problem test each account for 30%, and a final practical exam accounts for 40%. Students with exceptional reasons can request an exceptional evaluation, which mirrors the second call's examinations: a written theory test, a written problem test, and a final practical exam. In the second call of exceptional evaluation, students will repeat only the failed tests that were not compensated.
